title: Understanding Match Explanations
description: Learn how Notention explains why notes, people, and opportunities match your needs

steps.title: What Are Match Explanations?
steps.description: When Notention finds matches for your notes — whether it's relevant notes, potential connections, or opportunities — it provides explanations showing why each match was made. These explanations help you understand the reasoning and decide whether to act on the match.

steps.title: Explanation Components
steps.description: Each match explanation includes: 1) Match score (0-100%), 2) Key matching factors (shared tags, semantic similarity, network proximity), 3) Specific evidence (common topics, mutual connections, complementary skills), 4) Confidence level based on data completeness.

steps.title: View Match Details
steps.description: Click on any match card to see the full explanation breakdown

steps.title: Semantic Similarity
steps.description: Notention uses embedding-based semantic similarity to find conceptually related content, even when exact keywords don't match. This means 'project planning' can match 'task management' because they share underlying concepts.

steps.title: Network Proximity
steps.description: Matches from your network connections are boosted based on relationship strength. Direct connections have the highest boost, followed by second-degree connections. This helps you discover opportunities through people you trust.

steps.title: Skill Complementarity
steps.description: For collaboration matches, Notention identifies complementary skills — where one person's strengths fill another's gaps. This is shown as 'You have X, they need X' or 'They have Y, you need Y' pairs.

steps.title: Provide Feedback on Explanations
steps.description: Rate the helpfulness of explanations to improve future matches

steps.title: Feedback Recorded
steps.description: Your feedback helps refine the matching algorithm
